svg.text: Fourteen pipelines, each behind its own scheduler queue; integer queues are paired so an idle queue issues from its partner.
paired queues, idle one issues from its partner
queue size 13 each, or 24 to 28, disputed
four queues of 12, or one of 48, disputed
age matrix picks the oldest ready
dependents issue behind a load, speculatively
a shadow window reissues them on a replay
a fill wakes a missed load
one possibly mispredicting op issues a cycle
the unit 5 divider is a side pipe
AMX ops use the load and store pipes
